title: Section 62 BNS — Punishment for attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other imprisonment

content.heading: Punishment for attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment for life or other imprisonment
content.text: Whoever attempts to commit an offence punishable by this Sanhita with imprisonment for life or with imprisonment, or to cause such an offence to be committed, and in such attempt does any act towards the commission of the offence, shall, where no express provision is made for the punishment of such attempt, be punished as enacted. This is the successor of IPC 511.
